stem_book: A (uniform) disc is set rolling up an inclined plane of angle 30° from its base as shown. It is in continuous rolling on the plane up to height h = 1 m, then leaves the plane. If initially it had kinetic energy of 4 J, find the ratio of kinetic energy due to translation and rotation at maximum height of its trajectory (mass of disc is 0.1 kg; take g = 10 m/s²). (a) 1/2 (b) 3/2 (c) 3/4 (d) 2
work: KE at top = 4 − 0.1·10·1 = 3 J ⇒ KE_t = 2 J, KE_r = 1 J; in flight ω const, at max height KE_t = 2cos²30° = 1.5 J ⇒ 1.5/1 = 3/2
